semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in automated optical inspection equipment specifically designed for the semiconductor industry.
summary: SHYAWEI OPTRONICS CORPORATION, also known as Hsiangwei Optoelectronics Co., Ltd., focuses on developing automated optical inspection equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their products include machines for inspecting Mini LEDs, wafers, and glass holes, emphasizing defect detection and dimensional measurement to ensure quality control.
